title: Changing your password
summary: Change your own password any time. Forgot it? An admin resets it.

items: Open your user menu (website) or More › Account (app), then **Change password**.
Type your current password, then the new one (at least 8 characters).
Your other devices are signed out. This one stays signed in.
A longer password is safer. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
Never share your password, and never send it to support. KloudC will never ask for it.

blocks.text: Ask an admin at your store. They reset it on [Users](page:users), which signs you out everywhere at once. Then sign in with the new password and change it to your own.
